description: Build integration audit module to verify temporal_stability_enrichment is correctly wired to signal_analyser and that output flows to mcp_signal_enrichments. Must query: (1) does signal_analyser import temporal_stability_enrichment, (2) does it call compute_score and write result to mcp_signal_enrichments with signal_type='temporal_stability', (3) are there at least 100 rows in mcp_signal_enrichments WHERE signal_type='temporal_stability'. If check fails, report specific gap. Pure diagnostic, no DB writes, no network calls to external services. Reads source files and queries write_service only.
